rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (four shingles) with no theft or third-party involvement is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang—four shingles blown off, no interior leaking. Estimated repair cost $400. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will not result in a payout, but routed for record and potential reinspection.

case_facts.description: Wind damage - four shingles blown off overhang
